briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI push AGI timelines as compute race intensifies globally

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs continue rapid iteration with new model releases this month. Funding remains robust amid geopolitical tensions over chip access. Prompt injection attacks surge in production deployments.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with extended reasoning. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus while xAI deploys Grok-3 cluster for real-time training. DeepSeek open-sources v4 with 2T parameters.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. EU AI Act enforcement begins phase two with new red-teaming mandates.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Nvidia Blackwell ramp hits 500k units shipped. Google TPU v6 pods online in Iowa data center. Microsoft allocates $40B for AI-specific power infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent security protocols like DialectForge become mandatory for autonomous vehicle and BCI deployments by 2028?
